title: Allen Dulles witnessing a saucer

tellings.quote: absolutely this stuff I've heard the same stuff about uh Dulles and the you know witnessing the saucer and checks the lock and so on and so forth.

plain: Allen Dulles, a longtime head of the CIA, is said to have seen a flying saucer and checked that the door was locked, part of a story the philosopher Jason Jorjani says he has heard too. Jorjani mentions it only in passing to Michels, as something others have told him, and if true it would put the head of US intelligence among the witnesses.
